Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: individual fantasy companion portrait for the Aleria Almanach.
Create one complete, original portrait illustration of Isobel Draig's utterly pampered adult Lethin female cat. The cat is the dominant subject and fills most of the 2:3 composition, body and entire fluffy tail visible, viewed closely at cushion height.
BREED: a stately large long-haired palace cat, physically strong yet elegant, deep charcoal-black luxurious fur with softly defined slate highlights, a magnificent thick neck ruff, fluffy cheek tufts, long whiskers, alert warm golden eyes. Natural feline muzzle, not flat-faced. A distinct proud, imperious, almost comically self-satisfied expression, a spoiled aristocrat who knows the whole chamber belongs to her. This is a dark Lethin, NOT an orange tabby.
ACTION: seated comfortably on one thick wine-red velvet cushion with modest gold piping; the cushion visibly sinks beneath her. She is meticulously grooming herself, one forepaw naturally lifted to her muzzle, a tiny visible pink tongue licking the paw, the other front paw planted on the cushion, relaxed folded hindquarters and fluffy tail curled neatly along the front edge. Clear anatomically plausible feline grooming pose, exactly four legs. Golden eyes half-lidded with contented superiority, looking sidelong over the paw.
ACCESSORY: a delicate well-fitted deep-red velvet collar with one small, clearly readable heart-shaped ruby-red pendant edged in simple gold, nestled in the neck fur but still visible. No excessive jewelry.
SCENE: quiet comfortable medieval noble bedchamber, softly simplified pale stone window recess and a small portion of dark carved wood in the background; warm gentle afternoon window light illuminates the fur and cushion. Only the cat and cushion should command attention. No person, crown, text, watermark, extra animal or clutter. Fur drawn in clean designed anime tufts and cel-shaded masses, not individual photorealistic hairs. Strong personality and polished coherent character design, matching Aleria's established companion portrait series.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: individual fantasy companion portrait for the Aleria Almanach.
Create one complete original portrait of Carys Draig's adult hunting dog, a believable mixed-breed of the fictional Trywydd and Rhedwyr from Cenyr. ONE DOG ONLY. The animal fills most of the vertical 2:3 frame, whole body, all four paws, ear tips and long tail fully visible. Eye-level three-quarter side view, enabling clear appreciation of its silhouette and expressive face.
BREED COMBINATION: inherit the Trywydd's rough weatherproof wiry coat, useful muscular shoulders and sturdy adaptable working-dog nature, combined with the Rhedwyr's tall long legs, deep chest, distinctly tucked-up belly, narrow long muzzle, lean flexible outline and small folded-back or partly drooping ears. Like a distinctive athletic rough-coated lurcher, stronger through the shoulders than a pure slender greyhound, clearly lighter and more tucked up than a heavy wolfhound. No wolf-shaped head, no upright shepherd ears, no broad mastiff face, not a generic smooth greyhound.
INDIVIDUAL APPEARANCE: handsome warm grey-brown salt-and-pepper coat, darker along the back and ears, paler cream on the muzzle, chest and paws; slightly wiry eyebrows, a short scruffy beard, modest longer tufts at elbows and tail. Long gently curving tail held low. Intelligent warm amber-brown eyes, a dark nose. The fur is characterful and rustic but the animal is fit, cared for and healthy, not dirty or bedraggled.
PERSONALITY AND POSE: quietly standing on a woodland path, body angled across the image, head turned toward Carys just outside the frame as if awaiting her next hunting signal. One small folded ear slightly more attentive than the other, mouth closed, curious focused eyes and a confident, perceptive expression. Calm contained energy, independent clever hunter, poised and loyal without a human grin. All four feet naturally grounded, no running or leaping.
EQUIPMENT: one simple worn burgundy-brown leather collar with a small plain brass buckle, practical and restrained. No armor, packs, weapons, ribbons or extravagant jewelry.
SCENE: a quiet sunlit woodland edge near Celtigern's Watch, softened deciduous trees, a modest mossy low stone wall in the background and a little grass by the path. A few warm shafts of light, restrained background detail. No person, prey, additional animal, text, labels, watermark or visual clutter. Clean anime lineart, designed tufts of fur, clear cel-shaded shapes, coherent anatomy. The dog itself is the focus, matching Aleria's established companion portraits.
